__comment: Grafana dashboard JSON for the Phase-3c Cross-Welle-Coordination surface (Noa Bergstroem / SRE, Tag-38). Five-panel operator-view that unifies ADR-0066 Welle-1..7 status (Welle-1 v907_verify KW-24, Welle-2 svid_workload_identity KW-24, Welle-3 bridge_audit_writer KW-25 solo, Welle-4 state_backing KW-26, Welle-5 lifecycle_state_machine KW-26, Welle-6 subscribe_loop KW-27, Welle-7 recovery_workflow KW-27), cross-modul drift indicator for Doppel-Welle KW-26 (state_backing + lifecycle_state_machine, ADR-0066 Mitigation-1), per-welle BackendDecision-Aggregator snapshot (basis PR #179 backend-decision-observability.py emit-points), the aggregator-verdict-stream as self-evidence of ci-aggregator (ADR-0068 + Tag-38 aggregator-failure-rate-tracker.py wakir_aggregator_* gauges), and a Henrik-audit-sign-off PRE/TEL/POST-three-phase status indicator per Welle (per ADR-0066 §Henrik-Audit-Bandwidth-Bei-Doppel-Wellen). Schema version Grafana 10.x (schemaVersion 38). Sole datasource UID 'prom' (Prometheus). The two existing dashboards persona-engine-phase-3c-welle-status.json and persona-engine-backend-decisions.json remain the source-of-truth per-engine views; this dashboard is the *cross-welle*-roll-up that operators land on when triaging Phase-3c-marathon state.
title: Wakir - Phase-3 Marathon Live-Coordination

panels.title: Per-Welle Status (Welle-1..7, ADR-0066 Cutover-Plan)
panels.__comment: Row groups the seven per-welle state tiles. The persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_state gauge is produced by scripts/phase-3c-welle-status-emitter.py and carries one of the five state values: pre_cutover, in_cutover, post_cutover, rollback_active, welle_complete.

panels.title: Welle-3 bridge_audit_writer (KW-25, solo)
panels.__comment: Welle-3 is the Henrik-caution-solo welle (ADR-0066 §Welle-3). A red state here blocks Welle-4+5 from starting per ADR-0066 §Welle-3-immediate-rollback-trigger.

panels.title: Cross-Modul-Drift-Indicator (Doppel-Welle KW-26: Welle-4 + Welle-5)
panels.__comment: ADR-0066 Mitigation-1: Cross-Modul-Stress-Test in Phase-2-Acceptance-Gate. PR #178 extension. Red when cross_modul_pin_status=fail.

panels.title: Cross-Modul-Stress-Test Score (Welle-4 vs Welle-5 drift, 10s tick)
BackendDecision-Aggregator Snapshot pro Welle (PR #179)
panels.__comment: Per-component backend-decision counters from scripts/backend-decision-observability.py emit-points. The five domains (recovery, state_backing, fsm, v907_verify, bridge_diff) map to Welle-7, Welle-4, Welle-5 (lifecycle == fsm), Welle-1, Welle-3 respectively. Welle-2 (svid_workload_identity) and Welle-6 (subscribe_loop) do not have BackendDecision emit-points in PR #179 — those tiles show 'n/a'.

panels.title: Welle-5 fsm/lifecycle Rust-share
panels.__comment: domain=fsm maps to lifecycle_state_machine (Welle-5). PR #169 wired the emit-point.

options.content:
**Welle-2 svid_workload_identity (KW-24)** and **Welle-6 subscribe_loop (KW-27)** do not have a BackendDecision emit-point as of PR #179. SVID workload identity selects backend via SPIFFE-X.509-SVID lookup (no Rust/Python toggle); subscribe_loop is a NATS-side concern. Refer to the per-welle state tile (top row) for cutover status.

*Anchor*: `scripts/backend-decision-observability.py` PR #179, ADR-0066 §Wellen-Sequenz.

panels.title: Aggregator-Verdict-Stream (Self-Evidence ci-aggregator, ADR-0068)
panels.__comment: Self-evidence of the ci-aggregator workflow per ADR-0068 §Migration-Step-2. Source: scripts/observability/aggregator-failure-rate-tracker.py wakir_aggregator_* gauges. A non-zero wakir_aggregator_drift_events value blocks the Mira-Hand cutover (Migration-Step-3).

panels.title: Henrik-Audit-Sign-Off Status (PRE/TEL/POST 3-Phase, ADR-0066 §Henrik-Bandwidth)
panels.__comment: Per-welle three-phase audit-sign-off indicator. Source: wakir_henrik_audit_signoff{welle=...,phase=PRE|TEL|POST} gauge (0=pending, 1=signed, -1=blocked). Henrik's audit-trail-template (ADR-0066 Mitigation-2) emits this gauge from scripts/audit/henrik-signoff-emitter.py once that script lands. Until then, the tiles read 'pending' uniformly — an operator can override by writing the gauge value via the persona-engine Prometheus pushgateway.

options.content:
**Phase-3c Cross-Welle Coordination Dashboard** (Tag-38 Noa-SRE)

Five operator-views unified:

1. **Per-Welle Status** (top row): seven tiles, one per Welle, with the five-state mapping (pre/in/post_cutover, rollback_active, welle_complete) from `persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_state`.
2. **Cross-Modul-Drift-Indicator**: ADR-0066 Mitigation-1 for the KW-26 Doppel-Welle (Welle-4 state_backing + Welle-5 lifecycle_state_machine). Red when `phase_2_acceptance_gate_cross_modul_pin_status=fail`.
3. **BackendDecision Snapshot per Welle**: per-component Rust-share from PR #179 emit-points. Welle-2 + Welle-6 have no emit-point (architectural - see panel 26).
4. **Aggregator-Verdict-Stream**: ci-aggregator self-evidence (ADR-0068 §Migration-Step-2). Red drift-tile blocks Mira-Hand-cutover.
5. **Henrik-Audit-Sign-Off**: PRE/TEL/POST three-phase per-welle indicator (ADR-0066 §Henrik-Bandwidth).

*Anchors*: ADR-0066 (Phase-3c Beschleunigung), ADR-0068 (ci-aggregator), PR #179 (BackendDecision-Aggregator), `scripts/observability/aggregator-failure-rate-tracker.py` (Tag-38).

Related dashboards: `persona-engine-phase-3c-welle-status.json` (per-welle high-frequency view), `persona-engine-backend-decisions.json` (per-engine BackendDecision drill-down).

**Tag-40 Marathon-Live-Extension** appended below: per-welle Pre/Cutover/Post-Phasen, Marathon-Timeline (Gantt KW-24..27), Cross-Welle-Coordination-Indikatoren (Welle-3-Solo / Welle-4+5-Parallel / Welle-6+7-Parallel), Phase-3-COMPLETE-Marker (5-condition conjunction), Cutover-Day-Live-View, Marathon-Aggregat-Health-Score gauge.

panels.title: Tag-40 Marathon-Live: Pro-Welle Pre/Cutover/Post-Phasen (7 x 3 = 21 Panels)
panels.__comment: ADR-0066 Phase-3 Marathon Cutover-Plan. For each of the seven Wellen, three explicit phase status tiles: PRE (pre-cutover readiness), CUTOVER (in-progress), POST (post-cutover sign-off). Color mapping: grey=pending (state=0), blue=running (state=1), green=signed-off (state=2), red=rolled-back (state=3). Source metric: persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_phase_state{welle, phase} emitted by scripts/phase-3c-welle-status-emitter.py. The three-phase split is the operator's primary triage view during Marathon-KW-24..27.

panels.title: Tag-40 Marathon-Timeline (Gantt KW-24..27) + AR-Hand Sign-Off Decision Points
panels.__comment: Gantt-style horizontal-time-line view of the seven Wellen across calendar weeks KW-24..27 (one month). The state-timeline panel rendering plots each welle's phase progression on its own track; AR-Hand-Decision-Points (the Mira-Hand cutover sign-offs) appear as overlay annotations from wakir_ar_hand_signoff_event.

panels.title: Phase-3 Marathon Gantt-Timeline (KW-24..27, 7 Wellen, AR-Hand Sign-Off Markers)
Tag-40 Cross-Welle-Coordination-Indikatoren (Solo / Doppel-4+5 / Doppel-6+7)
panels.__comment: Three Marathon coordination markers per ADR-0066 §Welle-Sequencing. Welle-3-Solo: KW-25 with no parallel welle (Henrik full-audit-bandwidth). Welle-4+5-Parallel: KW-26 Doppel-Welle with cross-modul-stress-test gate. Welle-6+7-Parallel: KW-27 Doppel-Welle with subscribe-loop + recovery-workflow.

panels.title: Welle-3 SOLO Marker (KW-25, no parallel run)
Welle-4+5 DOPPEL Marker (KW-26 parallel, cross-modul gate)
Tag-40 Phase-3-COMPLETE-Marker (5-Konjunktion, Henrik-Spec)
panels.__comment: Henrik-Audit Phase-3-COMPLETE conjunction (ADR-0066 §Phase-3-Schluss-Akzeptanz). Phase-3 is declared COMPLETE only when ALL FIVE conditions are simultaneously green: (1) all 7 wellen welle_complete=true, (2) all 7 henrik PRE+TEL+POST signed, (3) zero rollback_active across all wellen, (4) cross_modul_drift_count = 0 for the duration of the marathon, (5) AR-Hand-Final-Sign-Off recorded. Each tile is a checkbox; the conjunction gauge below is computed from all five.

panels.title: Tag-40 Cutover-Day-Live-View (Mo KW-24/25/26/27): Live-BackendDecision + Latency-Histos + Drift
panels.__comment: On Cutover-Day (every Monday in KW-24..27) this row provides the operator's tactical view during the in-progress cutover. Three panels: live BackendDecision stream rate across all wellen (1m window), per-welle p50/p99 latency histograms (Rust vs Python backends), realtime cross-modul-drift indicator. Templating variable $welle filters to the currently-cutting-over Welle if operator selects one.

panels.title: Live BackendDecision Stream Rate (per Welle, 1m window)
Per-Welle p50/p99 Latency Histograms (Rust vs Python)
Tag-40 Phase-3-Marathon-Aggregat-Health-Score (0-100%)
panels.__comment: Single Marathon-Health gauge aggregating all 7 wellen. Formula: 100 * (welle_complete_fraction * 0.3 + henrik_signoff_fraction * 0.3 + (1 - rollback_active_fraction) * 0.2 + (1 - cross_modul_drift_normalized) * 0.1 + ar_hand_signoff_fraction * 0.1). Emitted by scripts/observability/phase-3-marathon-health-score.py as the recording-rule wakir_phase_3_marathon_health_score.

options.content:
**Tag-40 Marathon-Live-Coordination-Extension** (Noa-SRE)

Six operator-views appended on top of the Tag-38 cross-welle base:

1. **Pro-Welle Pre/Cutover/Post-Phasen** (21 panels, ids 101-121): 7 Wellen x 3 Phasen status tiles. Color-coding grey=pending, blue=running, green=signed-off, red=rolled-back. Source: `persona_engine_phase_3c_welle_phase_state{welle,phase}`.
2. **Marathon-Timeline** (panel 131): Gantt-style state-timeline KW-24..27, all 7 Wellen, AR-Hand Sign-Off annotation overlay from `wakir_ar_hand_signoff_event`.
3. **Cross-Welle-Coordination-Indikatoren** (panels 141-143): Welle-3-Solo (KW-25), Welle-4+5-Doppel (KW-26), Welle-6+7-Doppel (KW-27) topology markers.
4. **Phase-3-COMPLETE-Marker** (panels 151-156): 5-condition Henrik-Spec conjunction with checkbox visualization + final composite tile.
5. **Cutover-Day-Live-View** (panels 161-163): live BackendDecision rate, per-welle p50/p99 latency, realtime cross-modul-drift.
6. **Marathon-Aggregat-Health-Score** (panel 171): single gauge 0-100% aggregating welle_complete (30%) + henrik_signoff (30%) + no_rollback (20%) + no_drift (10%) + AR-Hand (10%).

*Anchors*: ADR-0066 (Phase-3c Beschleunigung, §Marathon-KW-24..27), Tag-40 auftrag (Noa-SRE), Henrik-Spec Phase-3-Schluss-Akzeptanz (5-Konjunktion).

*Companion alert rules*: `dashboards/phase-3-marathon-alerts.yaml` (welle-rollback, phase-3-complete-marker-false-positive, cross-modul-drift > 0).

panels.title: Tag-42 Pre-Cutover-Probe-Phase-Observability (Welle-1..7)
panels.__comment: Tag-42 Noa-SRE extension. Anchors: ADR-0066 AR-Hand-Gate, ADR-0065 Cutover-Plan, PR #267 Reza-Tag-41 Welle-1 probe reference impl. Source script: scripts/observability/pre-cutover-probe-failure-rate-tracker.py. Source metrics: wakir_pre_cutover_probe_*, wakir_marathon_readiness_score.

panels.title: Welle-1 Pre-Cutover-Probe Verdict
panels.__comment: Per-Welle current verdict tile. Source: wakir_pre_cutover_probe_verdict gauge from pre-cutover-probe-failure-rate-tracker.py.

panels.title: Per-Welle Probe-Verdict-Historie (Stability over Pre-Cutover-Window)
panels.__comment: Timeseries per Welle showing verdict over time. Stability (consecutive-GREEN >= 3) is the AR-Hand-Sign-Off-Pre-Condition (ADR-0066 AR-Hand-Gate).

panels.title: Probe-Verdict-Historie (alle 7 Wellen)
panels.__comment: Step-after timeseries (probe-verdict only changes at probe-run). Y=0..4 mapped to verdict colors. Operator reads horizontal-streak length as stability.

panels.title: Stability-Score (Consecutive-GREEN, Threshold = 3)
panels.__comment: Per-Welle consecutive-GREEN count from pre-cutover-probe-failure-rate-tracker WelleRollup.stability_consecutive_green. Green threshold at 3 == AR-Hand-Sign-Off-Pre-Condition met.

panels.title: Marathon-Readiness-Aggregate-Gauge (0-100%)
panels.__comment: Single 0-100% gauge derived from per-Welle verdict + Henrik-Sign-Off. Formula: 7x14.28pp verdict-weighted + 7x5pp Henrik-Sign-Off-Bonus, capped at 100. AR-Sitzung uses this gauge for the marathon-go-decision.

panels.title: Marathon-Readiness Breakdown per Welle
panels.__comment: Side-by-side table showing per-Welle verdict + Henrik + stability. Lets the operator see why the aggregate score is what it is.

panels.title: Welle-Coupling-Indikatoren (Pre-Condition-Matrix)
panels.__comment: ADR-0066 Coupling-Matrix: Welle-5 needs Welle-4 Cutover-Done; Welle-6 needs Welle-2 Cutover-Done; Welle-7 needs Welle-3 Sign-Off AND Welle-4 Cutover-Done. wakir_pre_cutover_coupling_pre_conditions_met == 1 means deps met.

panels.title: Welle-7 Coupling (needs Welle-3 Sign-Off + Welle-4 Cutover-Done)
Pre-Cutover-Audit-Trail (Henrik-Sign-Off-Status per Welle)
panels.__comment: Henrik-Pre-Audit-Sign-Off-Status per Welle. Source: Tag-39 + Tag-40 audit-spec deliverables published to reports/audit/henrik-pre-audit-signoffs.json. 1 = signed, 0 = unsigned.

panels.__comment: Per-Welle Cutover-Day-Window. Static recommendations from CUTOVER_DAY_WINDOWS in pre-cutover-probe-failure-rate-tracker.py + Kai-Runbook section 10. Operator reads as 'when is the cutover currently scheduled'. Dates RFC3339, slots CEST.

**Tag-42 Pre-Cutover-Probe-Observability-Extension** (Noa-SRE)

Six operator-views appended on top of the Tag-40 Marathon-Live base:

1. **7-Welle-Pre-Cutover-Probe-Status-Matrix** (panels 201-207): per-Welle stat-tile mapping `wakir_pre_cutover_probe_verdict` to GREEN/CAUTION/BLOCK/PENDING/NOT-EXEC color.
2. **Per-Welle-Probe-Historie** (panel 211 timeseries + panel 212 stability-bargauge): step-after timeseries of verdict over time + per-Welle consecutive-GREEN bargauge with threshold marker at 3 = AR-Hand-Sign-Off-Pre-Condition.
3. **Marathon-Readiness-Aggregate-Gauge** (panels 221+222): 0-100% gauge + side-by-side per-Welle breakdown table.
4. **Welle-Coupling-Indikatoren** (panels 231-233): Welle-5 Coupling (needs Welle-4), Welle-6 Coupling (needs Welle-2), Welle-7 Coupling (needs Welle-3 sign-off + Welle-4 cutover-done).
5. **Pre-Cutover-Audit-Trail-Panel** (panel 241): per-Welle Henrik-Pre-Audit-Sign-Off-Status from Tag-39 + Tag-40 deliverables.
6. **Cutover-Day-Window-Empfehlung-Panel** (panel 251): static per-Welle date+slot table from Kai-Runbook section 10.

*Anchors*: ADR-0066 AR-Hand-Gate, ADR-0065 Cutover-Plan, PR #267 Reza-Tag-41 Welle-1 probe reference impl.

*Source script*: `scripts/observability/pre-cutover-probe-failure-rate-tracker.py` (Tag-42 sister to PR #251 aggregator-tracker).

*Source metrics*: `wakir_pre_cutover_probe_verdict`, `wakir_pre_cutover_probe_stability_consecutive_green`, `wakir_pre_cutover_henrik_signoff`, `wakir_pre_cutover_coupling_pre_conditions_met`, `wakir_marathon_readiness_score`.

*Operator-Doku*: `docs/observability/pre-cutover-probe-dashboard.md`.
